episodes.title: Northwest Passages
episodes.plot: Maggie's birthday sparks a crisis over aging and accumulated loss, leading her to a Native ritual intended to release the past rather than keep cataloguing it.

episodes.title: Midnight Sun
episodes.plot: Endless summer daylight supercharges Joel's libido and attracts an adventure salesman, while Shelly's old cheerleading uniform unexpectedly energizes Holling.

episodes.title: Nothing's Perfect
episodes.plot: Chris accidentally kills a dog and falls for its mathematician owner, while Maurice buys a magnificent clock whose perfection proves more complicated than expected.

episodes.title: Heroes
episodes.plot: A visiting rock star becomes the subject of Ed's latest film and plans a Native collaboration, while Chris searches for the right way to honor a dead friend.

episodes.title: Blowing Bubbles
episodes.plot: Severely allergic Mike Monroe comes to Cicely seeking clean air inside a geodesic dome, while Ruth-Anne's polished, ambitious son visits and exposes family differences.

episodes.title: On Your Own
episodes.plot: The silent Flying Man returns with a mime troupe, while a ruby discovered inside a fish sends Ed into a romantic, cinematic fantasy about destiny.

episodes.title: The Bad Seed
episodes.plot: Holling meets an adult daughter he never knew existed and quickly decides she is a corrupting influence, while Ed forms an unlikely bond with a migrating crane.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.plot: Cicely mixes Thanksgiving with a Day of the Dead celebration, forcing Joel to confront a holiday culture very different from his own as Chris revisits painful memories.

episodes.title: Do the Right Thing
episodes.plot: A former KGB officer offers Maurice an embarrassing dossier, a zealous health inspector targets the Brick, and another death makes Maggie determined to live differently.

episodes.title: Crime and Punishment
episodes.plot: Chris is arrested for an old parole violation, and his extradition hearing becomes a community argument over law, character and whether Cicely can claim him as its own.

episodes.title: Survival of the Species
episodes.plot: Maggie's yard becomes an archaeological battleground, Ed prepares for environmental catastrophe, and a runaway boy working at the Brick develops an intense crush on Shelly.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.plot: Chris retreats to a monastery seeking spiritual clarity and encounters an unexpected attraction, while Ruth-Anne's final payment on her store irritates Maurice.

episodes.title: Duets
episodes.plot: Ed finally meets the man identified as his father, Maggie and Mike cross a romantic line, and an abrasive blind piano tuner disrupts the Brick.

episodes.title: Grosse Pointe, 48230
episodes.plot: Maggie brings Joel home to pose as her boyfriend at her grandmother's birthday, exposing him to family tensions, old romances and an unexpectedly athletic rivalry.

episodes.title: Learning Curve
episodes.plot: A rigid teacher makes Holling doubt his ability to earn a diploma and clashes with Maggie, while Joel frets helplessly over Marilyn's independent trip to Seattle.

episodes.title: Ill Wind
episodes.plot: A powerful wind seems to loosen everyone's restraints, provoking Joel and Maggie into open conflict, Chris and Maurice into a bizarre encounter, and Ed into thoughts of death.

episodes.title: Love's Labour Mislaid
episodes.plot: Joel is furious when Maggie forgets their intimate night, Uncle Anku urges Ed toward marriage, and Holling joins Ruth-Anne for an unexpectedly revealing birdwatching trip.

episodes.title: Northern Lights
episodes.plot: The winter solstice drives Chris toward a major art project and a denied vacation tempts Joel into unethical behavior, while Cicely rallies around a struggling veteran.

episodes.title: Family Feud
episodes.plot: A ceremonial totem-pole unveiling revives an old family feud, while Shelly tries marriage as a practical cure for increasingly vivid hallucinations.

episodes.title: Homesick
episodes.plot: Mike announces he is leaving just as Maggie plans a romantic dinner, Maurice relocates his ancestral home to Alaska, and Shelly's redecorating overwhelms Holling.

episodes.title: The Big Feast
episodes.plot: Maurice celebrates KBHR's anniversary with an exclusive party that draws Adam and Eve back to town and leaves an excluded Joel unusually wounded.

episodes.title: Kaddish, for Uncle Manny
episodes.plot: Joel searches Cicely for enough Jewish men to say kaddish for his uncle, while Chris and Bernard inherit a West Virginia blood feud and Marilyn chooses Holling as a dance partner.

episodes.title: Mud and Blood
episodes.plot: Spring arrives with mosquitoes and a truffle-hunting pig, awakening Holling's urge to plant and revealing a startling healing ability in Maggie.

episodes.title: Sleeping with the Enemy
episodes.plot: Maurice's old wartime hatred resurfaces when Duk Won asks permission to marry, while Ed works to preserve the Tlingit language and Holling confronts an unusual thirst.

episodes.title: Old Tree
episodes.plot: Maurice wants Cicely's ancient tree cut down as Joel fights to save it, Shelly cannot stop singing, and Maggie's relentless kindness nearly drives Joel mad.
